property_summary: For any recipient that is a plain non-precompile EOA and any deposit amount, after a creator-call to migrateTo(to) the contract's entire ETH balance has been transferred out (address(c).balance == 0); the mutant never sends and retains a nonzero balance for some inputs.
change_summary: Delete the payable(to).transfer(...) statement so migrateTo no longer sends the contract balance.
